events.status_note: Two intercepted alerts were referred to the general reference hospital.
events.evidence_quote: ces personnes ont toutes été référées à l’HGR de Bunia.

events.status_note: A two-day infection prevention and control briefing was initiated for healthcare providers at the clinics.
events.evidence_quote: Démarrage du briefing PCI pendant 2 jours à l’intention des prestataires de santé des cliniques de la MONUSCO à Goma

events.status_note: Five out of seven highly exposed staff members were evaluated after a confirmed Ebola case was present at the hospital center.
events.evidence_quote: évaluation de 5/7 personnel exposés à un cas confirmé de MVE au CH Félicité avec un degré d’exposition élevé

events.status_note: A supervision visit was conducted at the hospital center after it received five confirmed positive cases.
events.evidence_quote: supervision du CH LA VERITE ayant reçu 5 cas confirmés positifs
décontamination de 1 sur 2 ESS (CH DON DIVIN) dans la ZS de Katwa

events.status_note: The hospital received an infection prevention and control evaluation score of 42%.
events.evidence_quote: 2 à Katwa dont HGR KITATUMBA avec 42%, dispensaire Félicité (24,6%)

events.status_note: The dispensary received an infection prevention and control evaluation score of 24.6%.
events.evidence_quote: 2 à Katwa dont HGR KITATUMBA avec 42%, dispensaire Félicité (24,6%)

events.status_note: Infection prevention and control supplies were delivered to the hospital center.
events.evidence_quote: dotation des intrants PCI au CH Wanamahika dans la ZS de Katwa

events.status_note: The treatment centre was made operational.
People were sensitized at a health center and promised to pass the messages to their families.
events.evidence_quote: 1 042 personnes sensibilisées en milieu scolaire, académique, commercial, sportif et au Centre de Santé promettant

events.status_note: An educational talk on Ebola prevention measures was held with 28 mothers at the health center.
events.evidence_quote: causerie éducative avec 28 mamans lors de la CPN au CS Kavumu sur les mesures de prévention de la MVE

events.status_note: Seven recovered patients were discharged from the treatment centre.
events.evidence_quote: accompagner le déchargement de 7 guéris et sensibiliser sur l'efficacité de la prise en charge dans le CTE Rwampara.

events.status_note: Medicines were delivered to the treatment centre with support from ALIMA and IMC.
events.evidence_quote: Livraison des médicaments au CTE/HGR Bunia appui d’ALIMA et IMC.

events.status_note: Supervision visits were conducted at the treatment centre's depot where medicines and infection control supplies are stored.
events.evidence_quote: Visites de supervision au dépôt du BCZ Bunia et du CTE CME Bunia (lieu de stockage des médicaments et intrants PCI).

events.status_note: Standard treatment centres lack sufficient capacity despite the opening of this facility.
events.evidence_quote: Capacité insuffisante en CTE normés malgré l'ouverture de Rwampara
